message.content:
Based on my search, here are the best places to get tickets for the next NBA game:

## Official NBA Ticket Sources

### 1. **NBATickets.com** — The Official NBA Ticket Marketplace
This is the NBA's official one-stop shop for all ticket types for all teams:
- Buy single game tickets directly from the team
- Browse the official resale marketplace
- 100% authentic and verified tickets guaranteed
- Website: https://nbatickets.nba.com/

### 2. **Ticketmaster**
- The official ticketing partner of the NBA
- Provides the transactional engine that most NBA teams use
- When you click "Buy Tickets" on NBATickets.com, you'll typically be redirected here
- Offers verified ticket authentication technology

### 3. **Team Websites**
Each NBA team has its own official website where you can purchase tickets directly. This ensures you're getting first-issue tickets from the source.

## Other Authorized Options

### 4. **StubHub**
- A popular third-party resale platform
- Tickets are plentiful and may be cheaper closer to game time
- Be sure to understand the ticket transfer process

### 5. **AXS**
- Official ticket agent for certain NBA events (like NBA Global Games in Europe)
- Provides ticketing services for specific international games

## Tips for Buying NBA Tickets

- **Avoid scams**: Don't buy from strangers on social media or accept tickets as screenshots/photos
- **Digital tickets**: Make sure tickets can be officially transferred and added to your mobile wallet (Apple Wallet/Google Wallet)
- **Buy early**: Popular matchups sell out quickly
- **Compare prices**: Check both official and resale options

## For NBA Games in China

If you're looking for NBA games in China (like NBA Global Games), official partners have included:
- **Damai.cn** (大麦网)
- **NBA Tmall Store** at NBAStore.tmall.com
